WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, cp.brand,
       ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost),2) AS gross_margin,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost)/SUM(n.net_sales),1) AS gm_pct
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter=4 AND cs.region='South'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(v) AS net FROM (
    SELECT s.store_id, f.net_amount v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
     WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
     WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test') GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) c, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) cb FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, ROUND(m.net,2) mine, ROUND(c.c,2) ctl, ROUND(m.net-c.c,2) diff
FROM dim_store cs LEFT JOIN mine m USING(store_id) LEFT JOIN ctl c USING(store_id)
WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.region='South' ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nullcost, sum(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zerocost, sum(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost>f.net_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) costgtnet, sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonposnet, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff, sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) test
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND cs.region='South'
